instruction: A cinematic wide shot of a minimalist dance studio with a dark wall and wooden floor. In the foreground center-left, the bearded man in the brown shirt (R1) kneels on all fours with his head bowed. In the center, the woman in the yellow shirt (R2) performs a headstand, her legs split wide in the air. On the far left, the clean-shaven man in the brown shirt (R3) is also kneeling on all fours, while on the far right, the woman in the yellow shirt with a ponytail (R4) holds a back-bending headstand. In the background, two other dancers in matching attire kneel in similar poses. A warm spotlight from the right casts a bright flare across the moody, low-key scene.
elements: R1 kneels on all fours with his head bowed while R2 performs a split-leg headstand
R3 kneels on all fours while R4 holds a back-bending headstand
R2 is the split-leg headstand dancer, not R1
R1's role is an all-fours kneeling pose with head bowed
R4's role is a back-bending headstand
the dancers are on a wooden dance studio floor

questions.q: Is R1 kneeling on all fours with his head bowed while R2 performs a headstand with her legs split wide, rather than R2 kneeling on all fours and R1 doing the split-leg headstand?
questions.element: R1 kneels on all fours while R2 performs the split-leg headstand

questions.q: Is R4 holding a back-bending headstand while R3 is kneeling on all fours, rather than R3 holding the back-bending headstand and R4 kneeling on all fours?
questions.element: R4 performs the back-bending headstand while R3 kneels on all fours

questions.q: Is R2 the dancer balancing upside down in the wide split-leg headstand, rather than R1 being the one in that inverted split-leg pose?
questions.element: R2, not R1, is in the split-leg headstand

questions.q: Does R1 have the role of kneeling on all fours with his head bowed?
questions.element: R1's all-fours kneeling pose with head bowed

questions.q: Does R4 have the role of holding a back-bending headstand?
